title: OTC watchtower
summary: Expires stale cross-chain orders and relays revealed swap secrets, so a swap finishes even when a party goes offline.

requires: bitcoin-cli, for the Bitcoin secret scan (optional)

identity.how: keys.dat under the $HOME it runs with — a key made for the tower and funded for fees only; it never receives a swap's money (every payout goes to the party the contract names)

scan.summary: one pass over the open book — or a loop — expiring stale orders and settling ones whose secret it finds

l1.description: the L1 node to read and submit to

exec.description: the exec node serving the otc contract

cid.description: the otc contract id (found by its methods when not given)

btc_cli.description: a bitcoin-cli command line, to scan Bitcoin blocks for revealed secrets

btc_lookback.description: Bitcoin blocks scanned back on the first pass

secrets.description: a JSON file {orderId: 64-hex secret} to settle from

submit.description: actually post (without it, a dry run that prints what it would post)

loop.description: seconds between passes; 0 = one pass and exit

verify: Every effect is on-chain: an order it expired reads status refunded or cancelled, one it settled carries the revealed secret, in /exec/otc/order?id= — paid to the party the contract records, never to the tower.
